name: Joonho Lee
status: On military duty (until 2027.4.30., Technical Research Personnel)
bio: Robotics researcher and hands-on systems engineer, combining robot learning research with end-to-end development and real-world deployment. PhD from ETH Zurich’s Robotic Systems Lab, with a focus on legged robotics; now leading AI research for industrial robots at Neuromeka.
